lines.zh: 我一跳一跳，方脚掌拍着泥地。
lines.en: I hop along, square feet slapping the mud.

lines.zh: 每跳一下，喉咙就跟着呱一声。
lines.en: Each hop shakes a croak out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头跳到另一块，稳稳落住。
lines.en: I leap from stone to stone and land square.

lines.zh: 短腿摆得快，身子还是摇摇晃晃。
lines.en: My short legs move fast, my body still wobbles.

lines.zh: 泥水溅起来，沾在我方方的肚皮上。
lines.en: Mud splashes up and sticks to my boxy belly.

lines.zh: 我沿水洼边挪，怕晒干自己。
lines.en: I keep to the puddles, afraid of drying out.

lines.zh: 苔藓很滑，我滑了半步又站住。
lines.en: The moss is slick; I slide and catch myself.

lines.zh: 我蹦到高处，回头看刚才的路。
lines.en: I hop up high and look back at the way I came.

lines.zh: 篷车留下的辙印，我沿着走。
lines.en: I follow the ruts the caravan left behind.

lines.zh: 我跳过一根倒木，落地时呱了一声。
lines.en: I clear a fallen log and croak on landing.

lines.zh: 走一段就停，鼓一鼓我的喉咙。
lines.en: Every few hops I stop and puff my throat.

lines.zh: 这片叶子上有虫，我先记下。
lines.en: There's a bug on this leaf; I note the spot.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面跳，影子跟着一蹦一蹦。
lines.en: I hop low and my shadow bounces along.

lines.zh: 前面的草丛比我高，我照样钻。
lines.en: The grass ahead is taller than me; I push through.

lines.zh: 我跳上台阶，一级一级。
lines.en: I hop the stairs, one block at a time.

lines.zh: 露水打湿我的方脚掌。
lines.en: Dew soaks my square feet.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，喉咙一鼓一鼓地响。
lines.en: I squat and my throat swells and croaks.

lines.zh: 呱，呱，没人回答我。
lines.en: Croak, croak, and nobody answers.

lines.zh: 太阳晒着，我把自己摊成一块方石。
lines.en: The sun bakes me into a square green stone.

lines.zh: 我用前脚抹了抹脸。
lines.en: I wipe my face with a front foot.

lines.zh: 有只虫飞过，我眨了眨眼。
lines.en: A bug flies past and I blink at it.

lines.zh: 我回忆篷车上的摇晃。
lines.en: I remember the swaying of the caravan cart.

lines.zh: 水洼里映出我，方方的，很神气。
lines.en: The puddle shows me: square and rather proud.

lines.zh: 我鼓气，肚子涨成一个方块。
lines.en: I puff up until my belly is a cube.

lines.zh: 草丛里太安静，我忍不住呱一声。
lines.en: The grass is too quiet, so I croak once.

lines.zh: 舌头在嘴里卷好，随时能弹。
lines.en: My tongue is coiled and ready to snap.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面上的小虫，耐心地等。
lines.en: I watch a bug on the water and wait patiently.

lines.zh: 我从水洼里喝了一小口。
lines.en: I take a small sip from the puddle.

lines.zh: 四方身子晒热了，肚皮还是凉的。
lines.en: My top is warm; my belly stays cool.

lines.zh: 我数着过往的虫，一只也没数清。
lines.en: I count passing bugs and lose every count.

lines.zh: 我把身子缩成一小块。
lines.en: I fold myself down into one small block.

lines.zh: 我数着雨点落进水洼。
lines.en: I count raindrops hitting the puddle.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，方方的脸对着你。
lines.en: I raise my square face toward you.

lines.zh: 你不是虫，可你手上有虫味。
lines.en: You're no bug, but your hands smell of one.

lines.zh: 我跳到你鞋边，仰头看。
lines.en: I hop to your boot and look up.

lines.zh: 我呱一声，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I croak once, which counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我的眼睛就跟着转。
lines.en: When you move, my eyes swivel after you.

lines.zh: 我歪头研究你的高度。
lines.en: I tilt my head, studying how tall you are.

lines.zh: 你的影子很凉，我想待在里面。
lines.en: Your shadow is cool and I want to sit in it.

lines.zh: 我蹲着不动，只把喉咙鼓起来。
lines.en: I squat still and just puff my throat.

lines.zh: 你蹲下，我就蹦到你的影子里。
lines.en: You crouch, so I hop into your shadow.

lines.zh: 这双靴子踩过我的水洼，我记得。
lines.en: Those boots stepped in my puddle; I remember.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，又想起你太大，合上了。
lines.en: I open my mouth, remember you're too big, and close it.

lines.zh: 你看我，我也看你，谁先眨眼。
lines.en: You look at me, I look at you; who blinks first.

lines.zh: 呱！我跳开半丈远。
lines.en: Croak! I leap half a dozen feet away.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，肚皮露在外面。
lines.en: I roll over with my belly exposed.

lines.zh: 皮肤擦破了，黏黏的。
lines.en: My skin is scraped open and sticky.

lines.zh: 疼得我喉囊都瘪了。
lines.en: The pain deflates my throat sac.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿，先躲进草里。
lines.en: I drag one leg and hide in the grass.

lines.zh: 水里能止疼，我往水边跳。
lines.en: Water eases pain, so I hop toward the puddle.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打歪了半边脸。
lines.en: The blow leaves half my face crooked.

lines.zh: 我趴着，谁靠近都不信。
lines.en: I lie low and trust no one who comes near.

lines.zh: 我舔着破皮的地方，味道发苦。
lines.en: I lick the broken skin and it tastes bitter.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，我还跳得动。
lines.en: It hurts, but I can still hop.

lines.zh: 虫！我的舌头先动了。
lines.en: A bug! My tongue moves before I do.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，呱得很急。
lines.en: I stare at your hand and croak urgently.

lines.zh: 你把虫放低，我就跳过去。
lines.en: Lower the bug and I'll hop over.

lines.zh: 我蹦到你脚背上，等你给。
lines.en: I bounce onto your foot and wait.

lines.zh: 那味道让我喉咙鼓得发亮。
lines.en: The smell puffs my throat until it shines.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我就在旁边蹦。
lines.en: I won't snatch it; I'll just bounce nearby.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我的舌头够得着。
lines.en: A little closer and my tongue can reach.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，口水快滴下来了。
lines.en: My mouth is open and drool is about to drip.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我蹦两步跟着。
lines.en: You take one step and I hop two after you.

lines.zh: 是活的吗？动一下给我看。
lines.en: Is it alive? Move it once for me.

lines.zh: 我呱得很小声，怕吓跑它。
lines.en: I croak softly so I don't scare it off.

lines.zh: 这虫比我头还大，我不怕。
lines.en: This bug is bigger than my head; I'm not scared.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，舌头已经伸出去。
lines.en: I leap, tongue already out.

lines.zh: 给我，我拿影子跟你换。
lines.en: Give it to me and I'll trade you my shadow.

lines.zh: 你手上那只虫在动。
lines.en: That bug in your hand is moving.

lines.zh: 我蹲好，准备弹舌头。
lines.en: I crouch, tongue ready to snap.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的脚踝，呱了一声弹开。
lines.en: I bump your ankle, croak, and bounce away.

lines.zh: 呱！我翻了个身，又爬起来。
lines.en: Croak! I flip over and scramble up.

lines.zh: 我落地时屁股先着地，很丢脸。
lines.en: I land on my rear, which is embarrassing.

lines.zh: 你脚一动，我差点被踩着。
lines.en: Your foot shifts and I nearly get stepped on.

lines.zh: 我从你两腿之间挤过去，呱了一声。
lines.en: I squeeze between your legs with a croak.

lines.zh: 撞得我偏了方向，跳进草丛。
lines.en: The bump sends me off course into the grass.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，像在怪你。
lines.en: I look up at you as if it were your fault.

lines.zh: 我退开，鼓了鼓喉咙压惊。
lines.en: I back off and puff my throat to settle down.

lines.zh: 这一下把我方脚掌撞麻了。
lines.en: That knocked my square foot numb.

lines.zh: 我们都没受伤，我呱了一声算了。
lines.en: Neither of us is hurt, so I croak and let it go.

lines.zh: 她在水边，我跳过去，落了水。
lines.en: She's by the water; I hop over and land in it.

lines.zh: 我们一高一低地对着呱。
lines.en: We croak back and forth, one high, one low.

lines.zh: 两只方块蛙并排蹲着。
lines.en: Two cubefrogs squat side by side.

lines.zh: 我把刚抓的虫让给她。
lines.en: I offer her the bug I just caught.

lines.zh: 她跳，我跟着跳，路线一样。
lines.en: She hops, I hop, the same path exactly.

lines.zh: 我们的喉囊一起鼓起来。
lines.en: Our throat sacs swell at the same time.

lines.zh: 我绕着她蹦了一圈。
lines.en: I bounce one circle around her.

lines.zh: 她蹭我的肩膀，很轻。
lines.en: She nudges my shoulder, very gently.

lines.zh: 水里映出两个方块，靠得很近。
lines.en: The water shows two squares, close together.

lines.zh: 今晚这片水洼归我们俩。
lines.en: Tonight this puddle belongs to the two of us.

lines.zh: 舌头一卷，东西就进了嘴。
lines.en: One flick of my tongue and it's in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用前脚按住它，怕它跳走。
lines.en: I pin it with a front foot so it can't hop away.

lines.zh: 它黏在我舌头上，甩不掉。
lines.en: It sticks to my tongue and won't shake off.

lines.zh: 我叼着它跳了两步，差点吞了。
lines.en: I carry it two hops and almost swallow it.

lines.zh: 太沉了，我拖不动，只好放下。
lines.en: Too heavy; I can't drag it, so I let go.

lines.zh: 我不收藏东西，我只吃。
lines.en: I don't collect things; I just eat them.

lines.zh: 它从我嘴里蹦出去，我追。
lines.en: It springs out of my mouth and I chase it.

lines.zh: 我把虫放在叶子上，慢慢看。
lines.en: I set the bug on a leaf and study it.

lines.zh: 爪太短，抓不住圆东西。
lines.en: My claws are too short for round things.

lines.zh: 吃起来比拿着有意思。
lines.en: Eating is more fun than holding.

lines.zh: 我看见叶背上有只虫。
lines.en: I spot a bug on the underside of a leaf.

lines.zh: 我的眼珠先转过去，头才跟上。
lines.en: My eye turns first; my head follows.

lines.zh: 我蹲低，后腿收在身下。
lines.en: I crouch with my hind legs tucked under me.

lines.zh: 舌头在嘴里已经卷好了。
lines.en: My tongue is already coiled in my mouth.

lines.zh: 它飞一下，我记一下。
lines.en: It flits, and I mark where it lands.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我一跳就到。
lines.en: At this distance, one hop is enough.

lines.zh: 我蹲成一团，等它爬进舌头范围。
lines.en: I crouch into a lump and wait for it to enter tongue range.

lines.zh: 喉咙里没声音，我怕惊动它。
lines.en: My throat stays silent so I don't startle it.

lines.zh: 目标很小，但很肥。
lines.en: The target is small, but plump.

lines.zh: 就是现在，腿已经绷紧。
lines.en: Now — my legs are already tense.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像块湿石头。
lines.en: I hold still as a wet stone.

lines.zh: 它再爬一寸就到了。
lines.en: One more inch of crawling and it's mine.

lines.zh: 我算着风，风会吹偏舌头。
lines.en: I judge the wind; it could push my tongue off.

lines.zh: 眼睛锁着，呼吸也慢下来。
lines.en: My eyes lock on and my breathing slows.

lines.zh: 它翅膀一收，我的舌头也停住。
lines.en: Its wings fold, and my tongue stops mid-coil.

lines.zh: 我忍住了，没先跳。
lines.en: I hold back and don't jump first.

lines.zh: 影子挪过去，快盖住它了。
lines.en: My shadow creeps over it, almost covering it.

lines.zh: 我数着它的腿，四条。
lines.en: I count its legs: four.

lines.zh: 等它背对我，我就弹舌头。
lines.en: Once its back is turned, I snap my tongue out.

lines.zh: 舌头绷得像根湿绳。
lines.en: My tongue is taut as a wet rope.

lines.zh: 舌头弹出去，啪一声粘住。
lines.en: My tongue snaps out and sticks with a smack.

lines.zh: 我扑过去，整个方块身子压上。
lines.en: I lunge and land with my whole square body.

lines.zh: 咬下去，虫壳在我嘴里响。
lines.en: I bite down and the shell crunches.

lines.zh: 它在舌头上蹬了两下，软了。
lines.en: It kicks twice on my tongue, then goes limp.

lines.zh: 舌头收回来，带进一整只。
lines.en: My tongue pulls back with a whole bug on it.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把翅膀先扯掉。
lines.en: I shake my head to tear the wings off first.

lines.zh: 这一口咬偏了，我啃到叶子。
lines.en: This bite goes wide and I get a leaf.

lines.zh: 一整只滑下喉咙，鼓出个方块。
lines.en: The whole bug slides down and bulges my throat square.

lines.zh: 呱，抓到了，我告诉整片林子。
lines.en: Croak — I caught it, I tell the whole forest.

lines.zh: 舌头黏糊糊的，我抹在草上。
lines.en: My tongue is sticky, so I wipe it on the grass.

lines.zh: 我从篷车的木板缝里跳出来。
lines.en: I hop out from between the caravan's planks.

lines.zh: 第一声呱，吓飞了一只鸟。
lines.en: My first croak scares a bird away.

lines.zh: 湿叶子接住我，我没摔疼。
lines.en: Wet leaves catch me and I land unhurt.

lines.zh: 我抖抖身上的干草屑。
lines.en: I shake the dry straw off me.

lines.zh: 这里的水洼比篷车旁的大。
lines.en: These puddles are bigger than the ones by the cart.

lines.zh: 我蹲下，让露水打湿肚皮。
lines.en: I squat and let the dew wet my belly.

lines.zh: 我从高处跳到低处，练了三次。
lines.en: I practice three jumps from high ground to low.

lines.zh: 四周的虫鸣，我一只只听过去。
lines.en: I listen to the insects one by one.

lines.zh: 方脚踩进软泥，印子很整齐。
lines.en: My square feet press neat prints in the mud.

lines.zh: 新林子，先找水，再找虫。
lines.en: New forest: find water first, then find bugs.

lines.zh: 火燎到我，皮一下子皱起来。
lines.en: The flame catches me and my skin puckers.

lines.zh: 落地没踩稳，方脚折了一下。
lines.en: I land badly and one square foot bends.

lines.zh: 我划着短腿，水一直灌进嘴。
lines.en: I paddle my short legs while water pours in.

lines.zh: 冲击把我抛起来，我又落进水洼。
lines.en: The blast throws me up and I land in the puddle.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的背，带走一小块皮。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my back and takes skin with it.

lines.zh: 紫光压下来，我的后腿僵住了。
lines.en: Violet light presses down and my hind legs lock.

lines.zh: 我能听见虫叫，却一只也抓不到。
lines.en: I hear insects, yet catch none of them.

lines.zh: 雷落到附近，我的方脚还在发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits nearby and my square feet tingle.

lines.zh: 这里没有水也没有叶子，我跳不起来。
lines.en: No water, no leaves here; I cannot jump.
